# KONTAKT – Journal of Nursing and Social Sciences related to Health and Illness

EISSN 1804-7122; ISSN 1212-4117

**Founded:** 1999

**Indexing:** Web of Science (ESCI), Scopus, EBSCO, DOAJ, Crossref, ProQuest, Research4Life (Hinary
– biomedical and health literature)

**2025 CiteScore (Scopus): 0.9 **
**2025 Journal Impact Factor (Clarivate): 0.5 **
**5-year Impact Factor: 0.6 **
**2025 Journal Citation Indicator (Clarivate): 0.18 **
**2025 Acceptance Rate: 27 % **

Manuscripts can be submitted via online system only: [kont.zsf.jcu.cz][68]

### WARNING: All citations in the manuscript must be traceable to the original sources; do not use
### AI!

It is the official journal of the Faculty of Health and Social Sciences of the University of South
Bohemia in Ceske Budejovice in the Czech Republic, published quarterly in English language. KONTAKT
accepts for publication original research, review articles, letters to editor and interesting case
reports, on all aspects of nursing, health and social problems related to health and illness. The
journal is registered in Bibliographia medica Cechoslovaca (BMC) and is a member of COPE (Commitee
on Publication Ethics).

KONTAKT is an open access journal. KONTAKT levies an article-processing charge of **€ 300** for each
article accepted for publication, plus VAT or local taxes where applicable. This fee helps to cover
part of the publishing costs. Submitted, but not accepted articles are not charged.

Editorial office accepts articles in English language, in Czech and Slovak language are acceptable
as well. After reviews, Czech and Slovak corrected versions are sent to authors for translation. All
articles are reviewed by at least two independent reviewers. The review process is reciprocally
anonymous. Without English version, the article can not be published.

#### Articles are published in two sections:

**1. The nursing section** focuses on the support of nursing via the dissemination of the latest,
evidence-based peer reviewed findings. The section serves as a forum for the exchange of knowledge
relating to the education of nurses, the exchange of knowledge and skills in clinical nursing, the
development of nursing concepts and innovation in health policy. It deals with the legal and ethical
issues, nurses' views on patient safety, nursing activities in multicultural environments and
progress in nursing practice.

The main topic areas include:
* Clinical nursing
* Management in nursing
* Evidence-based nursing
* Multicultural nursing
* Nursing ethics
* Quality of life in illness

**2. The social sciences in health section** accepts contributions relating to any aspect of health
from a broad perspective of the social sciences, including the medical impact on society. It also
accepts contributions dealing with ethical issues in health care, risk management and the impact of
political and economic conditions in the field of health. The aim of the articles is to develop
understanding and to provide practical application of quantitative and qualitative research methods
concerning the management, application or use of the research in health and social care.

The main topic areas include:
* Social determinants of health
* Social work and health
* Legal and economic issues concerning health
* Ethical issues in social sciences and health

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic
signal processing, electro-physiological signal processing, intelligent network platform
construction, and algorithms. Some of our team members come from the design and manufacturing
industries of intelligent electronic products, with the ability to transform blueprints into
reality. Others are from top medical equipment companies worldwide, who possess a profound insight
into the global medical market.

Minttihealth has a valuable resource of expert clinical medical professionals, who act as the
primary data entry for our telemedicine system. With their extensive clinical experience combined

prevention. Starting with the hardware/software technology of the medical Internet of Things, we are
committed to optimizing disease management and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment practices. Our
primary focus is on the application of medical and health big data analysis and intelligence (AI),

with live cardiopulmonary sounds with greater clarity. It allows safe distance auscultation and

monitoring, postoperative care for cardiac patients and health management for the elderly etc.

algorithm. It can measure temperature with the highest degree of medical accuracy for all ages.

# Pain management without compromise

What if you could have effective pain management *and* an improved path to healing? OrthoCor’s
wearable products offer patients a powerful, noninvasive, non-pharmaceutical option for managing
pain and charting a path toward wellness.

[ Explore the technology ][22]
[A man wearing a black orthopedic shoulder brace with a circular electronic control module, shown in
a circular-cropped lifestyle image.]
[a graphic of someone holding their knee with visible knee pain and inflammation]

### Reduce pain & inflammation^{[1][23]}

OrthoCor devices deliver powerful relief for post-operative, acute, arthritic, and chronic pain ––
without the risks of pharmaceutical or invasive alternatives.
[a physical therapist helping a man use an elastic band to help stretch his arm and hand]

### Promote healing

OrthoCor devices help address the root causes of pain, actively stimulating the healing cascade by
increasing blood flow and reducing inflammation.
[a woman wearing a helmet and riding a bicycle]

### Keep moving

Devices can be worn on the go, which means patients can experience meaningful pain relief without
putting their lives on pause.

## Real results. Genuine relief.

OrthoCor outcomes are backed by extensive evidence supporting better pain management for multiple
patient types.

[42% reduction in average pain score]
[55% reduction in daily pharmacologic use]
[ Access the research ][24]

### How it works

Using advanced PST technology, OrthoCor’s family of pain management devices pulse precisely timed
magnetic waves through affected areas—unfelt by the patient—triggering a natural biological reaction
that combines therapeutic relief with an enhanced healing process.

[ Explore the technology ][25]
[A person wearing an Active System brace on their back]
[a white Activ8 Logo]

### Extended pain management

For patients living with chronic pain, Activ8 devices enable a life filled with less discomfort,
promoting better long-term outcomes and more activity.

[ Explore Activ8 ][26]
[A person wearing an Active System brace around their knee]
[an Active System Logo in white]

### Enhanced healing support

For patients recovering from an injury or operation, the Active System relieves pain while
encouraging the body’s natural healing processes.

[ Explore Active System ][27]
Until I started OrthoCor, pain was a daily companion. After just 12 weeks of using the OrthoCor
daily and a week of every-other-day use, I now have no pain whatsoever.
– OrthoCor Patient
[– OrthoCor Patient]
I can't take NSAIDs because they upset my stomach. My knee doesn't lock up when I use it at night.
It has great improved my sleep.
– B.R.
[quotation icon]
Such a great device. It's the perfect solution between my knee injections for pain.
– K.P.
[quotation icon]
[a NewOptions logo in white]

### Supportive bracing

New Options Sports offers another layer of support to post-operative and arthritic patients, as well
as athletes of all kinds.

**We’re proud to manufacture each of our braces in the USA.**

[ Explore bracing products ][28]
[OrthoCor products made in USA]
[a collage of Active System devices]

Learn more about:
* How to get the most from your device
* How to get a new device
* Warranties and returns
* FAQ

# Pain management without compromise

What if you could have effective pain management *and* an improved path to healing? OrthoCor’s
wearable products offer patients a powerful, noninvasive, non-pharmaceutical option for managing
pain and charting a path toward wellness.

[ Explore the technology ][22]
[A man wearing a black orthopedic shoulder brace with a circular electronic control module, shown in
a circular-cropped lifestyle image.]
[a graphic of someone holding their knee with visible knee pain and inflammation]

### Reduce pain & inflammation^{[1][23]}

OrthoCor devices deliver powerful relief for post-operative, acute, arthritic, and chronic pain ––
without the risks of pharmaceutical or invasive alternatives.
[a physical therapist helping a man use an elastic band to help stretch his arm and hand]

### Promote healing

OrthoCor devices help address the root causes of pain, actively stimulating the healing cascade by
increasing blood flow and reducing inflammation.
[a woman wearing a helmet and riding a bicycle]

### Keep moving

Devices can be worn on the go, which means patients can experience meaningful pain relief without
putting their lives on pause.

## Real results. Genuine relief.

OrthoCor outcomes are backed by extensive evidence supporting better pain management for multiple
patient types.

[42% reduction in average pain score]
[55% reduction in daily pharmacologic use]

# Better
# Pain Management
# Is possible.

# Transforming how the world treats pain

For too long, people have had to settle for pain therapies that were considered “good enough”. We,
however, refuse to settle. Pacira is leading a new era in pain management through the delivery of
precise, targeted non-opioid treatments aimed at transforming the lives of patients.
Our non-opioid therapies address a diverse range of needs for chronic, postsurgical and
musculoskeletal pain.
[See our therapies][46]
The opioid epidemic shows the need for safer pain management — our resources can guide you to
treatment options that may be right for you.
[Explore our insights][47]

## Big science for big breakthroughs

Pacira is focused on developing solutions for unmet musculoskeletal and adjacent pain management
needs by actively researching advanced therapies, including a promising gene therapy with the
potential to transform the treatment of chronic pain.

[View our innovative pipeline][48]

## Exploring non-opioid therapies for pain relief

To redefine the future of pain management, we must imagine a world where patients recover faster and
move forward with less pain. This short film—produced for Pacira by BBC StoryWorks Commercial
Productions—showcases how non-opioid innovation is helping make that future possible.

[Watch the film][49]
[bbc documentary]

## Meaningful change

We’re leading the way in the science of pain management, which includes the fight to expand use and
access to safe and effective non-opioid therapies. We have always believed actions speak louder than
words—and that education and advocacy are paramount toward raising the bar in patient care.

[Learn about our impact][50]

# Better
# Pain Management
# Is possible.

# Transforming how the world treats pain

For too long, people have had to settle for pain therapies that were considered “good enough”. We,
however, refuse to settle. Pacira is leading a new era in pain management through the delivery of
precise, targeted non-opioid treatments aimed at transforming the lives of patients.
Our non-opioid therapies address a diverse range of needs for chronic, postsurgical and
musculoskeletal pain.
[See our therapies][46]
The opioid epidemic shows the need for safer pain management — our resources can guide you to
treatment options that may be right for you.
[Explore our insights][47]

## Big science for big breakthroughs

Pacira is focused on developing solutions for unmet musculoskeletal and adjacent pain management
needs by actively researching advanced therapies, including a promising gene therapy with the
potential to transform the treatment of chronic pain.

[View our innovative pipeline][48]

## Exploring non-opioid therapies for pain relief

To redefine the future of pain management, we must imagine a world where patients recover faster and
move forward with less pain. This short film—produced for Pacira by BBC StoryWorks Commercial
Productions—showcases how non-opioid innovation is helping make that future possible.

[Watch the film][49]
[bbc documentary]

## Meaningful change

We’re leading the way in the science of pain management, which includes the fight to expand use and
access to safe and effective non-opioid therapies. We have always believed actions speak louder than
words—and that education and advocacy are paramount toward raising the bar in patient care.

[Learn about our impact][50]

## Join us in making a difference

Our teams are united by a passion for excellence and a commitment to patients. Here, you can grow
your career while making a real impact.

### **Empowering healthcare professionals**

PAJUNK^{®} is a global medical technology company developing and manufacturing needles, catheters
and system solutions for regional anesthesia, pain management, neurology, biopsy and minimally
invasive procedures.

At PAJUNK, medical innovation starts with clinical reality. We work in direct collaboration with
healthcare professionals worldwide to translate clinical needs into practical, reliable and
high-precision medical devices designed for everyday clinical use. Our mission is to enable medical
professionals worldwide to focus on what really matters: their patients.

We combine the strength of a global leader in regional anesthesia with the agility of a
technology-driven medical device manufacturer to support healthcare professionals in their daily
work.

 

### **Medical device solutions across clinical fields**

PAJUNK develops and supplies medical devices for:

Regional Anesthesia

Full range of solutions for spinal, epidural and [combined spinal-epidural][86] (CSE) techniques,
nerve blocks, stimulation-guided procedures and wound infiltration.

[Learn more][87]

Pain Management

Medical devices for ultrasound- and fluoroscopy-guided pain management procedures, including
specialty injection needles, radiofrequency systems and procedural components.

[Learn more][88]

Neurology & Neurorehabilitation

Devices designed to support diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitative procedures in the field of
neurology and neurorehabilitation.

[Learn more][89]

Biopsy

Modular biopsy systems and access devices for a wide range of image-guided diagnostic tissue
sampling procedures.

[Learn more][90]

Minimally Invasive Surgery

Modular access and procedural solutions supporting a wide range of minimally invasive surgical
techniques.

[Learn more][91]

### **Developed and manufactured in-house**

PAJUNK mainly designs and manufactures its medical devices in-house, including the customized
production equipment used in manufacturing. All products are developed in compliance with
international medical device regulations and quality standards.

 

### **High-tech engineering with a human focus**

PAJUNK combines medical engineering, clinical expertise and ergonomic design to create products that
support healthcare professionals in complex clinical environments. Our goal is to provide reliable,
precise and practical tools that help clinicians focus on what matters most: patient care.

 

### **Beyond products:**
### **education and clinical partnership**

PAJUNK supports healthcare professionals through hands-on clinical training, structured education
programs and long-term professional partnerships. Our [PAJUNK Education][92] platform provides:
* Live and on-demand webinars on regional anesthesia, pain management and neuromodulation
* On-site cadaver workshops for advanced procedural training
* Clinical insights and practitioner-focused articles developed in collaboration with healthcare
  professionals

 

 
* What is PAJUNK?
  
  PAJUNK is a medical technology company that develops and manufactures devices for regional
  anesthesia, pain management, neurology, biopsy and minimally invasive medical procedures.
* What does PAJUNK specialize in?
  
  PAJUNK specializes in needles, catheters and procedural systems designed to support precise,
  image-guided and interventional medical techniques.
* Is PAJUNK a manufacturer or a distributor?
  
  PAJUNK is a medical device manufacturer. Product development, engineering and production are
  mainly carried out in-house.
* Where are PAJUNK products developed and produced?
  
  PAJUNK products are mainly developed and manufactured in Germany using proprietary production
  technology and quality-controlled processes.
* Who uses PAJUNK medical devices?
  
  PAJUNK products are used by anesthesiologists, pain specialists, neurologists, radiologists,
  surgeons, and other healthcare professionals in hospitals, clinics, and specialized practices.
* What clinical fields does PAJUNK serve?
  
  PAJUNK provides solutions for regional anesthesia, pain management, neuromodulation,
  musculoskeletal procedures, biopsy and minimally invasive medicine.
* Does PAJUNK work with clinicians?
  
  Yes. PAJUNK collaborates closely with healthcare professionals through clinical partnerships, user
  feedback and clinical studies to guide product development.
* What is PAJUNK Education?
  
  PAJUNK Education is the company’s clinical education platform, providing training, webinars and
  workshops for healthcare professionals.

### **Empowering healthcare professionals**

PAJUNK^{®} is a global medical technology company developing and manufacturing needles, catheters
and system solutions for regional anesthesia, pain management, neurology, biopsy and minimally
invasive procedures.

At PAJUNK, medical innovation starts with clinical reality. We work in direct collaboration with
healthcare professionals worldwide to translate clinical needs into practical, reliable and
high-precision medical devices designed for everyday clinical use. Our mission is to enable medical
professionals worldwide to focus on what really matters: their patients.

We combine the strength of a global leader in regional anesthesia with the agility of a
technology-driven medical device manufacturer to support healthcare professionals in their daily
work.

 

### **Medical device solutions across clinical fields**

PAJUNK develops and supplies medical devices for:

Regional Anesthesia

Full range of solutions for spinal, epidural and [combined spinal-epidural][86] (CSE) techniques,
nerve blocks, stimulation-guided procedures and wound infiltration.

[Learn more][87]

Pain Management

Medical devices for ultrasound- and fluoroscopy-guided pain management procedures, including
specialty injection needles, radiofrequency systems and procedural components.

[Learn more][88]

Neurology & Neurorehabilitation

Devices designed to support diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitative procedures in the field of
neurology and neurorehabilitation.

[Learn more][89]

Biopsy

Modular biopsy systems and access devices for a wide range of image-guided diagnostic tissue
sampling procedures.

[Learn more][90]

Minimally Invasive Surgery

Modular access and procedural solutions supporting a wide range of minimally invasive surgical
techniques.

[Learn more][91]

### **Developed and manufactured in-house**

PAJUNK mainly designs and manufactures its medical devices in-house, including the customized
production equipment used in manufacturing. All products are developed in compliance with
international medical device regulations and quality standards.

 

### **High-tech engineering with a human focus**

PAJUNK combines medical engineering, clinical expertise and ergonomic design to create products that
support healthcare professionals in complex clinical environments. Our goal is to provide reliable,
precise and practical tools that help clinicians focus on what matters most: patient care.

 

### **Beyond products:**
### **education and clinical partnership**

PAJUNK supports healthcare professionals through hands-on clinical training, structured education
programs and long-term professional partnerships. Our [PAJUNK Education][92] platform provides:
* Live and on-demand webinars on regional anesthesia, pain management and neuromodulation
* On-site cadaver workshops for advanced procedural training
* Clinical insights and practitioner-focused articles developed in collaboration with healthcare
  professionals

 

 
* What is PAJUNK?
  
  PAJUNK is a medical technology company that develops and manufactures devices for regional
  anesthesia, pain management, neurology, biopsy and minimally invasive medical procedures.
* What does PAJUNK specialize in?
  
  PAJUNK specializes in needles, catheters and procedural systems designed to support precise,
  image-guided and interventional medical techniques.
* Is PAJUNK a manufacturer or a distributor?
  
  PAJUNK is a medical device manufacturer. Product development, engineering and production are
  mainly carried out in-house.
* Where are PAJUNK products developed and produced?
  
  PAJUNK products are mainly developed and manufactured in Germany using proprietary production
  technology and quality-controlled processes.
* Who uses PAJUNK medical devices?
  
  PAJUNK products are used by anesthesiologists, pain specialists, neurologists, radiologists,
  surgeons, and other healthcare professionals in hospitals, clinics, and specialized practices.
* What clinical fields does PAJUNK serve?
  
  PAJUNK provides solutions for regional anesthesia, pain management, neuromodulation,
  musculoskeletal procedures, biopsy and minimally invasive medicine.
* Does PAJUNK work with clinicians?
  
  Yes. PAJUNK collaborates closely with healthcare professionals through clinical partnerships, user
  feedback and clinical studies to guide product development.
* What is PAJUNK Education?
  
  PAJUNK Education is the company’s clinical education platform, providing training, webinars and
  workshops for healthcare professionals.
* What makes PAJUNK different from other medical device companies?
  
  PAJUNK combines in-house engineering, close clinical collaboration and high-precision
  manufacturing to develop practical solutions for everyday medical procedure
* Is PAJUNK a global company?
  
  Yes. PAJUNK supplies medical devices to healthcare systems worldwide through international
  subsidiaries and trusted distribution partners.

## OUR STORY

Teikoku Pharma USA is a global pharmaceutical company with a focus on developing topical
Transdermal, oral, and therapies in the areas of non-opioid pain management, CNS disorders, and
dermatology. Our Lidoderm (Lidocaine 5% Patch) product has helped millions of patients worldwide.

We explore a variety of opportunities to develop drugs that improve patient lives and take an
opportunistic approach to our programs, both independently and collaboratively with like-minded
partners.

[ LEARN MORE ][26]

FEATURED PRODUCT

#### TPU-006: 4-Day Dexmedetomidine Patch

TPU-006 is an investigational non-opioid analgesic designed to deliver dexmedetomidine for four days
or longer post-surgery.

[ LEARN MORE ][27]

## PRODUCT PORTFOLIO

[

##### Lidoderm®

Lidocaine 5% Patch (US)

Lidoderm was the first prescription hydrogel patch approved in the United States for post-herpetic
neuralgia (PHN). This pioneering transdermal technology provides pain relief after a shingles
infection for up to three days.

Learn More
][28]
[

##### Versatis®

Lidocaine 5% Patch (EU)

A topical 5% medicated lidocaine plaster prescribed for the management of neuropathic pain
associated with previous herpes zoster infection (post-herpetic neuralgia, PHN)1, also known as
after-shingles pain.

Learn More
][29]
[

##### Docetaxel

Alcohol-free Injection

Docetaxel is a non-alcohol taxane injection indicated for the treatment of breast cancer, non-small
cell lung cancer, prostate cancer, gastric adenocarcinoma, and head and neck cancer.

Learn More
][30]

RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT

#### Uncovering What’s Possible

As a global pharmaceutical company with deep expertise in dosage form development plus comprehensive
manufacturing capabilities, we create both the formulations and the delivery mechanisms that bring
first and best in class therapies to life.

[ VIEW PIPELINE ][31]

of life-changing drug therapies.

# TRANSFORMING LIVES. ELEVATING CARE.

Teikoku Pharma is a global pharmaceutical company that develops life-changing therapies through
advanced science and technical ingenuity.

[ CONTACT US ][22]
[

LEARN MORE
][25]

## OUR STORY

Teikoku Pharma USA is a global pharmaceutical company with a focus on developing topical
Transdermal, oral, and therapies in the areas of non-opioid pain management, CNS disorders, and
dermatology. Our Lidoderm (Lidocaine 5% Patch) product has helped millions of patients worldwide.

We explore a variety of opportunities to develop drugs that improve patient lives and take an
opportunistic approach to our programs, both independently and collaboratively with like-minded
partners.

[ LEARN MORE ][26]

FEATURED PRODUCT

#### TPU-006: 4-Day Dexmedetomidine Patch

TPU-006 is an investigational non-opioid analgesic designed to deliver dexmedetomidine for four days
or longer post-surgery.

[ LEARN MORE ][27]

## PRODUCT PORTFOLIO

[

##### Lidoderm®

Lidocaine 5% Patch (US)

Lidoderm was the first prescription hydrogel patch approved in the United States for post-herpetic
neuralgia (PHN). This pioneering transdermal technology provides pain relief after a shingles
infection for up to three days.

Learn More
][28]
[

##### Versatis®

Lidocaine 5% Patch (EU)

A topical 5% medicated lidocaine plaster prescribed for the management of neuropathic pain
associated with previous herpes zoster infection (post-herpetic neuralgia, PHN)1, also known as
after-shingles pain.

Learn More
][29]
[

##### Docetaxel

Alcohol-free Injection

Docetaxel is a non-alcohol taxane injection indicated for the treatment of breast cancer, non-small
cell lung cancer, prostate cancer, gastric adenocarcinoma, and head and neck cancer.

Learn More
][30]

RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT

#### Uncovering What’s Possible

As a global pharmaceutical company with deep expertise in dosage form development plus comprehensive
manufacturing capabilities, we create both the formulations and the delivery mechanisms that bring
first and best in class therapies to life.

[ VIEW PIPELINE ][31]

of life-changing drug therapies.

Non-Narcotic Solutions to Reduce Healthcare Costs & Enhance Recovery

# Revolutionizing Pain Management Techniques

Our commitment to reducing over-utilization of narcotics and opiates is matched only by our
dedication to providing effective modalities that support recovery after injury.

As [leaders in the industry][22], Ultra Pain Products strives to stay at the forefront of pain
management solutions and offer the latest advancements in pain relief. With a focus on practicality
and efficacy, our goal is clear: to reduce the economic burden on the healthcare system and prevent
lost working days due to injury or surgery.

Join us in embracing a healthier, more efficient approach to pain management as we introduce you to
cutting-edge [pain management devices][23]. Your patients will say goodbye to a reliance on
narcotics and welcome a future of increased functional abilities and improved quality of life.



(833) ANTI-PAIN

## A Multi-Faceted Approach to Pain Relief

Our mission goes beyond delivering pain management devices. We aim to:



### Reduce The Economic Burden On The Healthcare System

By providing safe and alternative home-based treatment modalities, we help to continue the healing
process from home – reducing the costs associated with prolonged recovery and related
complications. 



### REDUCE The USE Of Narcotic/Opioids

Our products provide a non-narcotic adjunctive therapy option to help manage pain. We believe in
promoting safer pain management practices.



### Minimize Lost Working Days For Injured Workers

For individuals affected by work-related or auto-related injuries, our solutions aid in faster
recovery and a swift return to work.

## Non-Surgical, Pain-Free Products

## Preferred PainShield Provider

Ultra Pain Products is the exclusive distributor of the [PainShield][24]® in the USA. Our focus on
work-related and auto-related injuries makes us the preferred provider for the injury community. By
offering opioid-free non-invasive pain management alternatives, we ensure patients receive the best
care possible and are on the right road to recovery.

[Home Based Recovery | UltraPain Products]

### Home-Based Recovery

Providing convenience and comfort, our devices are designed for effective pain management in the
comfort of your patient’s home.

[Anti Opioid Initiative | UltraPain Products]

### Anti-Opioid Initiative

We actively contribute to reducing over-utilization of opioids by offering safe and efficient
alternatives.

[best in class medical devices |UltraPain Products]

### Best-In-Class Medical Devices

We strive to provide patients with top-quality medical devices suited for their individual recovery
processes, addressing both acute and chronic pain.

# Leading Importer, Distributor & Manufacturer’s
# Representative in India for chemicals.

# Strong Sourcing Expertise & excellent Relationship with Global Chemical Manufacturers.

# Strong experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Import & Export of wide array of Chemicals.

### Introduction

Incorporated in 1991 by Mr. Jiten Dadia, Venus International is a Mumbai, India based organization
engaged in Import and Distribution of a range of speciality chemicals from Internationally reputed
sources. Blending together a wide base of knowledge along with years of experience, we are a
one-stop shop for all your Chemical requirements. Our products have cross-industry applications in
the fields of Dyes & Pigments, Pharmaceuticals & Bulk Drug intermediates, Agro-Chemicals, Paints &
Coatings, Lubricants, Greases & Metal-Working Fluids, Home & Personal Care Products, Adhesives,
Resins & Plasticizers, Plywood & Laminates, Rubber & Electronics, Aromatics, Textile Auxiliaries,
Food and Flavours, Specialty Chemicals & other related Industries. We represent highly reputed
global chemical manufacturers from India and overseas.

Our avant-garde set up in Santacruz, Mumbai is well equipped to handle large scale transactions of
chemicals. A highly qualified management team under the aegis of Mr. Jiten Dadia forms the crux of
the company with a high level of knowledge on the subject matter. The company has access to skilled
engineers, technical experts and other resources handling operations, packaging & logistics as per
requirement. We believe in a no-compromise policy on Quality Assurance, Quality Control & EHS
(Environmental Health & Safety) factors

[Image ]

### Vision

To create business value by supplying exceptional range of chemicals of Internationally approved
quality for our clients, blended with immaculate pre sales support and post sales service.

### Mission

To cater the increasing demands of chemical consumers with ethical business practices, wide-range of
innovative products, timely delivery and competitive prices thereby rendering support for prolonged
business relations.

### Values
* Safe business conduct
* Ethics and Integrity
* Strict observance of regulatory and legal requirements
* Respecting diverse perspectives

# Leading Importer, Distributor & Manufacturer’s
# Representative in India for chemicals.

# Centred on Innovative Solutions, Value-Addition & Commitment.

# Strong Sourcing Expertise & excellent Relationship with Global Chemical Manufacturers.

# Strong experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Import & Export of wide array of Chemicals.

### Introduction

Incorporated in 1991 by Mr. Jiten Dadia, Venus International is a Mumbai, India based organization
engaged in Import and Distribution of a range of speciality chemicals from Internationally reputed
sources. Blending together a wide base of knowledge along with years of experience, we are a
one-stop shop for all your Chemical requirements. Our products have cross-industry applications in
the fields of Dyes & Pigments, Pharmaceuticals & Bulk Drug intermediates, Agro-Chemicals, Paints &
Coatings, Lubricants, Greases & Metal-Working Fluids, Home & Personal Care Products, Adhesives,
Resins & Plasticizers, Plywood & Laminates, Rubber & Electronics, Aromatics, Textile Auxiliaries,
Food and Flavours, Specialty Chemicals & other related Industries. We represent highly reputed
global chemical manufacturers from India and overseas.

Our avant-garde set up in Santacruz, Mumbai is well equipped to handle large scale transactions of
chemicals. A highly qualified management team under the aegis of Mr. Jiten Dadia forms the crux of
the company with a high level of knowledge on the subject matter. The company has access to skilled
engineers, technical experts and other resources handling operations, packaging & logistics as per
requirement. We believe in a no-compromise policy on Quality Assurance, Quality Control & EHS
(Environmental Health & Safety) factors

[Image ]

### Vision

To create business value by supplying exceptional range of chemicals of Internationally approved
quality for our clients, blended with immaculate pre sales support and post sales service.

### Mission

To cater the increasing demands of chemical consumers with ethical business practices, wide-range of
innovative products, timely delivery and competitive prices thereby rendering support for prolonged
business relations.

### Values
* Safe business conduct
* Ethics and Integrity
* Strict observance of regulatory and legal requirements
* Respecting diverse perspectives
